content.title: Pre-Application Meetings
content.summary: Pre-application meetings provide an opportunity for development applicants to discuss proposed projects with City staff, including representatives from Development Services, Fire Marshal's Office, and Public Works. These meetings help applicants understand environmental, land use, and permit requirements to submit a complete application.

steps.title: Schedule a Pre-Application Meeting
steps.text: Contact the Development Services Department at 425-489-2754 to schedule a pre-application meeting.

steps.title: Prepare Application Materials
steps.text: Provide a draft site plan, grading plan, storm drainage plan, and building elevations if developed to assist in the discussion.

steps.title: Attend the Meeting
steps.text: Meet in-person at Woodinville City Hall or virtually on Wednesdays at 9 and 10 am with City staff and possibly a City consultant to discuss the project, identify fatal flaws, major code requirements, and necessary permits.

required_documents.name: Draft Site Plan
required_documents.description: A preliminary layout of the project site.

required_documents.name: Grading Plan
required_documents.description: A plan showing proposed grading and earthwork.

required_documents.name: Storm Drainage Plan
required_documents.description: A plan detailing stormwater management for the project.

required_documents.name: Building Elevations
required_documents.description: Drawings showing the exterior views of proposed buildings, if developed.

form_fields.label: Project Description
form_fields.description: A brief description of the proposed development project.
form_fields.why_needed: To understand the scope and nature of the project.

form_fields.label: Contact Information
form_fields.description: Applicant's contact details for communication purposes.
form_fields.why_needed: To coordinate meeting scheduling and follow-up.

faqs.a: No, the pre-application meeting is optional but encouraged to assist in submitting a complete application.

faqs.q: Who should attend the pre-application meeting?
faqs.a: The applicant, and optionally an engineer or architect, along with City staff from Development Services, Fire Marshal's Office, and Public Works.
Pre-application meetings are held in-person or virtually on Wednesdays at 9 and 10 am.

faqs.q: Can pre-application meetings be used for special event permits?
faqs.a: Yes, pre-application meetings are also held to review Special Event Permit Applications. Contact the City to determine if your event requires a permit.
